claims.quote: components in the canonical synaptic vesicle fusion SNARE complex (VAMP2, STX1A/B, and SNAP25)

Mutations to components in the canonical synaptic vesicle fusion SNARE complex (VAMP2, STX1A/B, and SNAP25) and a key regulator of SNARE complex formation MUNC18-1, produce variant phenotypes of autism, intellectual disability, movement disorders, and epilepsy.
